text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite the early hour, I can hear
Bamboo
Memory enthusiastically
greeting everyone at the
academy gate.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yup! I'm super well-rested from my day
off!
choice_data_list_en: You're awfully early today, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I even woke up before my alarm today! I
started
the day off with a win and I'm
feeling great!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
From here on out, I'm giving 110
percent!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory seems to be
well-rested.
